56313daa59.q: How does Google Business Profile help law firms get visibility in AI search results?
56313daa59.a: Google Business Profile is an opportunity to inject information about your business directly into Google's database. Service descriptions and business profile details are powerful ways to inject information that the AI algorithms use to learn more about your firm and represent you in AI overviews.
56313daa59.e: The New Rules of Search: AI, Google & Law Firm Visibility with Brad Wetherall

dcb7567c48.q: What changed in Google search rankings now that AI Overviews are displayed at the top of search results?
dcb7567c48.a: Being number one in organic results is no longer what it used to be because you are below the fold. The new number one is to be in the AI Overview, which is now at the top of the page. People investing in old school SEO strategies with backlinking are really just optimizing the bottom of the page.
dcb7567c48.e: The New Rules of Search: AI, Google & Law Firm Visibility with Brad Wetherall

592cf9cdc8.q: Why does AI-generated content no longer work for law firm websites?
592cf9cdc8.a: Between Q1 2023 and Q1 2024, the internet grew 2800 percent because people were creating massive amounts of AI-generated content, and Google noticed it was all the same. Google changed its search algorithm to de-index AI-generated content that was not unique or adding anything new to the conversation. The key is making sure you inject your perspective and human intelligence so the content is unique.
592cf9cdc8.e: The New Rules of Search: AI, Google & Law Firm Visibility with Brad Wetherall

f7f782be0a.q: How did Brad Wetherall's background in software engineering and operations at Google prepare him to advise law firms on AI search optimization?
f7f782be0a.a: Having a software engineering background allows him to understand how systems work and explain the architecture of Google products so people can use them correctly. After leaving Google two years ago, he now has flexibility to explain how products were designed and their intended operation, something Google did not do well. He commonly uses the analogy of someone driving a Ferrari backwards and needs to turn it around.
f7f782be0a.e: The New Rules of Search: AI, Google & Law Firm Visibility with Brad Wetherall

3c2363ea3b.q: What are the five key areas law firms need to focus on for AI and future search according to Brad Wetherall's book?
3c2363ea3b.a: The five areas are: website technical design and schema optimization, content quality that includes your unique perspective, Google Business Profile with service descriptions, reputation management through reviews on GBP and other platforms, and public relations with brand mentions. Brand mentions are probably the biggest differentiator for AI optimization.
3c2363ea3b.e: The New Rules of Search: AI, Google & Law Firm Visibility with Brad Wetherall

32376158a4.q: How should law firms prioritize between Google Business Profile reviews and Facebook or Reddit reviews for AI visibility?
32376158a4.a: Different LLMs weight them differently, but Google would weight GBP reviews higher than Facebook since Meta is a competitor. Claude or ChatGPT may reference Facebook or Reddit reviews, with Reddit being popular for opinions. However, prioritize GBP reviews because Google still drives most traffic to law firm websites, and Google weights its own reviews higher and has additional metadata to verify review quality.
32376158a4.e: The New Rules of Search: AI, Google & Law Firm Visibility with Brad Wetherall
